verdict.rationale: Ollama's own docs list first-party Python and JavaScript/TypeScript libraries for using Ollama from applications, so the core of building against official SDKs is delivered. The evidence is a set of short headline mentions rather than in-depth reference material. Missing for 10: detailed SDK reference docs (method coverage such as streaming and tool calling, plus SDK versioning), SDKs beyond Python and JS/TS, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
